instruction: Everything in my amazon cart is for my friend, Adam. Request them money for it on venmo. Ignore tax and delivery fees from the cart cost.
notes: Supervisor, amazon, phone and venmo are used. The cart subtotal (items only, no tax/delivery) is modeled as a static fact (cart-subtotal) that amazon.show_cart discovers (found-cart-cost); Adam's email is a static contact fact discovered via phone.search_contacts (known-email). venmo.create_payment_request must use the discovered email and the discovered cart cost, creating exactly one payment request record; no description/private flags are needed since the evaluation only checks receiver and amount. supervisor.complete_task takes no answer (the task is not a question) and is forced last via the (task-completed) convention; its extra non-API parameters only serve to check the goal condition structurally.
